purpose: Flag likely Standard Estonian morphological and lexical leakage in intended Mulgi text, while allowing authentic Mulgi features (-b/-p 3sg present, q-less forms, -me/-mä ma-infinitive, -n/-nd participles, -n inessive, -ge comitative, -ss translative/conditional, -te/-de abessive).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian active past participle -nud. Mulgi uses -n, -nd, or -nu/-nü (e.g. ollu/oln, tennü/tend), not -nud.
rules.hint: Use Mulgi active past participle morphology (-nu/-nü/-n/-nd).

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian passive past participle -tud/-dud. Mulgi uses -t/-d, -tu/-tü, or -du/-dü.
Looks like Standard Estonian past negation ei + -nud/-tud. Mulgi past negation uses es + verb (es tii, es ole).
rules.hint: Use Mulgi es past negation, not Estonian ei + -nud.

rules.message: Standard Estonian contracted negation pole/polnud/poleks/polevat is an Estonianism in Mulgi.
rules.hint: Use Mulgi ei ole / es ole / ess ole.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian 3pl present -vad. Mulgi 3pl present uses -ve/-va (e.g. tegeve, tuleva, eläve).
rules.hint: Use Mulgi 3pl ending (-ve/-va/-vä), not Standard Estonian -vad.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian impersonal -takse/-dakse. Mulgi uses -tes/-tas/-des/-das (e.g. tetäs, üteldäs).
May be Standard Estonian simple past -sin/-sime/-site (Mulgi commonly uses -si/-sime/-site in some subvarieties, or -i/-ssi; check local Karksi/Halliste/Helme/Tarvastu/Paistu paradigm).
rules.hint: Verify against genuine Mulgi past forms rather than copying Standard Estonian.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian conditional -ksin/-ksime/-ksite. Mulgi conditional uses -ss/-ssi/-se (e.g. oless, tess).
Looks like Standard Estonian illative -sse. Mulgi uses short/geminate illative or -de/-te/-he (e.g. tupa, linna, metsä, kätte).
rules.hint: Use a Mulgi illative form instead of Estonian -sse.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian plural illative -desse/-tesse.
rules.hint: Use Mulgi plural illative (-tes/-de/-he or stem illative).

rules.message: May be Standard Estonian plural partitive -sid. Mulgi prefers vowel plural (-e/-i/-u) or -sit/-id.
rules.hint: Check whether a Mulgi vowel plural or -id/-sit partitive is more idiomatic.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian -mas supine. Mulgi supine inessive is -men/-man/-män (or -meh).
rules.hint: Check whether this should be Mulgi -men/-man/-män.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian -mata abessive. Mulgi supine abessive typically uses -mete/-made/-malda or -te/-de.
Looks like Standard Estonian translative -ks. Mulgi translative uses -ss or -s.
rules.hint: Rewrite translative noun/adjective ending with Mulgi -ss or -s.

rules.message: Check whether Standard Estonian pronoun/adverb leaked where Mulgi prefers sii, nii, väige, pallu, nüid, misperäst, kuis (note: kes/mis overlap in some contexts).
rules.hint: Use Mulgi sii (= see), nii (= need), mia/mina, sia, nüid/nüüd, pallu where authentic.

do_not_flag_suffixes.reason: Mulgi 3sg present legitimately uses -b/-p (or endingless in some types).
Mulgi ma-infinitive ends in -me/-mä (e.g. Karksi eläme, tegeme), not only 1pl.
Mulgi inessive is -n (kodon, mõtsan) and past participle can end in -n/-nd.
Mulgi translative and conditional both use -ss.
